visual.issue: Single-page photos show the whole page shrunk to about half the frame instead of a large crop of the useful part (r013), with big empty bands above and below. Their alt text says 'the top of ... large' and lists only the top sections, but the full page is in frame (r005).

Two-page photos shrink two whole pages side by side, so the table headers, routine items, habit-tracker numbers and year-page dates are tiny at Etsy zoom (r013). The alt text says 'the tops of' each page, but whole pages are shown.

Week 1 (Dec 28 to Jan 3) draws Mon to Thu Dec 28-31 in faded gray at about 2:1 contrast, as if they were outside the planner. These are real planner days, with no other page for them, so a buyer in the last week of December sees greyed boxes for this week.
